nodes.label: The Whole Brain Thing
nodes.definition: The full stack of cognitive operations — consciousness, thought, memory, the works. Not the meat, the vibe the meat produces.

nodes.label: Meat Computer
nodes.definition: The physical organ actually running the simulation. Wetware. Three pounds of galaxy-brain potential.

nodes.label: The Codec
nodes.definition: The system we use to compress thoughts into sounds and symbols others can decode. Lossy compression at best.

nodes.label: Processing...
nodes.definition: What's happening when you're staring at the ceiling at 3am. Manipulation of information, concepts, and takes.

nodes.label: What It's Giving
nodes.definition: The semantic payload of a sign or utterance. What it actually communicates vs what it literally says.

nodes.label: The Sigil
nodes.definition: A sign that stands in for something else by convention. The map is not the territory but the symbol is pointing at it.

nodes.label: The No-Cap Rules
nodes.definition: Formal principles for reasoning without getting ratio'd. The laws that make inference not just vibes.

nodes.label: The Signal
nodes.definition: Data that actually reduces uncertainty. The opposite of noise. If it tells you nothing new, it's mid.

nodes.label: The Recurring Bit
nodes.definition: Structure that keeps showing up. Your brain is literally a pattern-matching machine and this is what it finds.

nodes.label: Built Different (How)
nodes.definition: The arrangement of parts and how they relate. What makes a thing the shape it is rather than a pile.

nodes.label: When It Goes Crazy
nodes.definition: When a bunch of simple things interact and suddenly something complex appears that wasn't in any of the parts. Unhinged.

nodes.label: It's Giving Chaos
nodes.definition: So many interacting parts that predicting behavior from components alone is cooked. You need to watch the whole thing.

nodes.label: Zoom Out Arc
nodes.definition: Removing specific details to see the general shape. Trading accuracy for portability. The vibe without the specifics.

nodes.label: The Sim
nodes.definition: A simplified version of the system used to understand or predict it. Every model is wrong, some are useful.

nodes.label: The Stand-In
nodes.definition: Something that proxies for something else. The word 'fire' doesn't burn but it represents burning.

nodes.label: Mental Reps
nodes.definition: All the brain activity involved in knowing things — perceiving, remembering, inferring. The cognitive grind.

nodes.label: The Bucket
nodes.definition: A group of things that share enough vibes to be treated the same. How your brain avoids processing every object from scratch.

nodes.label: What Even Exists Tho
nodes.definition: The branch of philosophy asking what kinds of things actually exist. Getting very fundamental about reality.

nodes.label: Meaning Studies
nodes.definition: The formal study of what words and sentences actually mean. Asks 'but what does it signify' about everything.

nodes.label: Context Is Everything
nodes.definition: How meaning shifts based on context, speaker intent, and situation. 'That's interesting' can mean many things.

nodes.label: Grammar But Real
nodes.definition: The rules for how symbols can be arranged into valid structures. Violated constantly but it still holds things together.

nodes.label: Running The Numbers
nodes.definition: Transforming inputs to outputs via well-defined steps. Turns out a lot of cognition is basically this.

nodes.label: The Recipe
nodes.definition: A finite, unambiguous set of steps for solving a problem. Deterministic. No vibes, just procedure.

nodes.label: The Web
nodes.definition: Interconnected nodes and edges. Everything interesting is a network. Brains, internet, social graphs, all of it.

nodes.label: Downloading Skills
nodes.definition: Updating your internal model based on experience. The process by which you go from not knowing to knowing.
